raw_http_text: {"id":"c30197fe-56a8-469f-83ae-c7416abcdd7b_2y2t9mg3z7kxazf1fk_c1b02b4bf8434edabe2a0c415e618ec8","choices":[{"finish_reason":"stop","index":0,"message":{"content":"{\"schema_version\":\"1.0\",\"packet_id\":\"CAND_TOPIC_01_R2_V1\",\"mode\":\"organized_reflection\",\"sentences\":[{\"text\":\"人类活动使大气二氧化碳增加，溶入海洋的二氧化碳也随之增加，但未给出某年吸收比例、速度或上限。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E04\"],\"kind\":\"paraphrase\"},{\"text\":\"海洋酸化指氢离子浓度上升、pH下降的方向，海水平均仍呈碱性却可继续酸化，两者并不矛盾。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E05\"],\"kind\":\"limitation\"},{\"text\":\"NASA区分观测与归因：变绿检出依赖数据，各驱动因素作用大小需借助模型判断。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E06\"],\"kind\":\"paraphrase\"},{\"text\":\"在观测到叶面积增加而各驱动因素贡献需模型判断的条件下，能否据此推断某因素的独立作用已获直接测得？\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E06\"],\"kind\":\"question\"}]}","role":"assistant","tool_calls":null}}],"created":1794399604,"model":"mimo-v2.6-flash","object":"chat.completion","usage":{"completion_tokens":211,"prompt_tokens":1754,"total_tokens":1965,"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":0},"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":1664}}}
